title: AgentOps Cross-Family Pawl Verdict v1
description: The machine-checkable cross-family verdict that authorizes a mutate-shared-trunk pawl (merge/push to main). Written by the /pre-land-refuters (or /council) gate after the panel runs; read by scripts/reconcile-pr.sh BEFORE it merges. Green CI is necessary but NOT sufficient: a merge requires this artifact to exist, be tied to THIS bead+PR, and carry BOTH cross-family refuters CONFIRMED. Fail-closed by construction: absent artifact, wrong bead/PR, fewer than two distinct families, any non-CONFIRMED refuter, or an escalate/hold disposition => the gate refuses the merge. The companion free-form council narrative still lives at .agents/council/YYYY-MM-DD-pre-land-*.md; THIS file is the checkable summary the merge path enforces against. Runtime artifact lives at .agents/pawl-verdicts/<bead-id>.json (untracked); this schema and its fixtures are tracked.

bead_id.description: The bead this verdict authorizes. reconcile-pr.sh requires this to equal the bead it is closing.

pr.description: The PR number this verdict was produced against. reconcile-pr.sh requires this to equal the PR it is merging — a verdict for a different PR does not transfer.

head_sha.description: Optional: the PR head commit the panel reviewed. When present, reconcile-pr.sh may require it to match the PR's current head so a verdict cannot be reused across new pushes.

disposition.description: Panel-level disposition. CONFIRMED = both cross-family refuters confirmed and the panel authorizes the door. REFUTED = at least one refuter refuted; do NOT merge, re-work and re-gate. ESCALATE / HOLD = the models could not converge (reviewer deadlock, N attempts exhausted, or an explicit judgment flag); do NOT merge, surface for human resolution. Only CONFIRMED authorizes the merge; everything else fail-closed HOLDs.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the panel recorded this verdict.

attempt.description: Which re-gate attempt produced this verdict (default 1). After N (default 3) the disposition must be ESCALATE/HOLD, never CONFIRMED on a streak of REFUTEDs.

refuters.description: The cross-family refuter panel. At least two refuters from at least two distinct model families, each prompted to refute, each read-only and stake-free. The merge requires EVERY refuter to be CONFIRMED and at least two distinct families represented.

family.description: The reviewer's model family (e.g. 'claude'/'fable', 'codex'/'gpt', 'gemini'/'agy'). At least two DISTINCT families must appear across the refuters.

reviewer.description: Optional reviewer/session identifier (must differ from the authoring worker session).

verdict.description: This refuter's verdict. Both refuters must be CONFIRMED for the panel to authorize the door.

evidence.description: Optional pointer to the grounding evidence (the real tests/build that ran, the council narrative anchor, the pinned-fixture sweep).

council_artifact.description: Optional path to the free-form council narrative (.agents/council/YYYY-MM-DD-pre-land-<slug>.md) this summary was distilled from.
